name: opencode_console
description: Pay-as-you-go model inference through OpenCode Console's OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini-compatible APIs
long_description: Bring an OpenCode Console API key (oc_sk_...); the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key lists the models its workspace can use (GET /console/api/v1/models), which costs nothing. A Sprite can then call paid Console models through OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Gemini generateContent, create embeddings, and list models. Every inference request is charged to the workspace balance at the model's price. OpenCode Go routes, the /images generation and edit routes, System One decision models, connected-provider routes and every key, member, budget, billing and workspace endpoint are not forwarded.

examples.title: List the models this key's workspace can use
Chat completion with GLM 5.3 Flash (spends workspace credits)
notes: `usage.cost` in the response is what the request cost in US dollars. Free-tier models answer 403 outside OpenCode; use a paid model.

Anthropic Messages with Claude Haiku 5.5 (spends workspace credits)

messages.400: OpenCode Console rejected the request (%{status}); check the model ID and body
messages.402: OpenCode Console balance or budget exhausted; add credits or raise the budget in the Console
messages.403: This OpenCode Console key lacks permission for this request; restricted keys need Models › Request, and free-tier models only work inside OpenCode
messages.429: OpenCode Console rate limit reached; wait for Retry-After and retry
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach OpenCode Console; retry later

presentation.tagline: Call OpenCode Console models from a Sprite without putting your oc_sk_ key on it.
presentation.setup: In the OpenCode Console (opencode.ai/console), add credits, then open Account › Personal API keys and click Add API key, or create a key for a service account under Settings › Service accounts. A key with Restricted permissions and Models set to Request is enough. The key starts with `oc_sk_` and is shown once.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /console/api/v1/models` and costs nothing; listing models is free too. Every chat completion, response, message, Gemini and embeddings request is charged to the workspace balance at the model's per-token price (for example GLM 5.3 Flash at $0.15 input and $0.50 output per 1M tokens), and counts toward the member's or service account's budget. The Gemini route also serves the Nano Banana 2.1 image model, priced per output image. Each response reports its cost in `usage.cost` (`usageMetadata` for Gemini).

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /console/api/v1/models`, `GET /inference/v1/models`, `POST /inference/openai/v1/chat/completions`, `POST /inference/openai/v1/responses`, `POST /inference/openai/v1/embeddings`, `POST /inference/anthropic/v1/messages` and `POST /inference/google/v1beta/models/MODEL:generateContent` (or `:streamGenerateContent`) are forwarded. OpenCode Go (`/inference/go`), the `/images` generation and edit routes, System One decision models, connected-provider routes (`/inference/custom`) and key, member, budget, billing and workspace management are not.

usage_notes: The gateway waits 120 seconds for response headers and OpenCode documents no timeout parameter. For long generations or reasoning models, stream (`stream: true`, or `:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse` for Gemini) so headers arrive at once, and cap `max_tokens`.
Each model is served natively by one API family, but every paid text model also works through the other APIs, which Console translates. See opencode.ai/docs/console/models#endpoints.

Error bodies follow each API's shape: `{"error": {"type", "message"}}` for OpenAI, `{"type": "error", "error": {...}}` for Anthropic, `{"error": {"code", "status", "message"}}` for Gemini, and `{"_tag": "Unauthorized"}` for the Console model list.
